build_profile_conditions_from_IMAS: build a profile_conditions dict for TORAX config from an IMAS core_profiles IDS
build_plasma_composition_from_IMAS: build a plasma_composition dict for TORAX config from an IMAS core_profiles IDS
test_profile_conditions_from_IMAS: test profile_conditions_from_IMAS with a core_profiles IDS containing electron and ion temperature profiles
test_plasma_composition_from_IMAS: test plasma_composition_from_IMAS with a core_profiles IDS containing multiple ion species and impurities
review_profile_conditions_from_IMAS: review profile_conditions_from_IMAS to convert IMAS core_profiles data into TORAX-compatible profile conditions
